verdicts.note: Attacked on confidence: the only substantive source is her own pamphlet statement [S1]. But tenure is a matter of record rather than a policy claim (clerk 'for the last 12 years', '23 years of experience'), and she runs explicitly on continuing to serve. -2 high stands. Minor wording point: 'three-term' in the basis is an inference from 12 years; the dossier does not say how many times she was elected.

No elected office, challenging a 12-year incumbent on 'modernization' [S1], but her case rests on five years inside the clerk's office as a lead deputy and current court work [S1]. That is an insider-credential challenger, so +1 rather than +2; medium fits a single clear source.
